execution_contract.neural_execution: Frozen seed-2102 and seed-2103 checkpoint replay on a visible CUDA GPU; no training, adaptation, compilation, or parameter update occurs in v2.4.
execution_contract.cpu_threads: PyTorch intra-op and inter-op threads fixed to one by configure_runtime; NumPy and BLAS settings unchanged.
execution_contract.joint_result_write: Both seeds are evaluated in one process and the result is written only after both complete.

result_contract: The first v2.4 evaluation may run only after this implementation lock, the runner, and tests are committed and pushed to origin/dev.
immutability: Any execution repair after evaluation begins requires a superseding implementation lock naming the defect; the admission equation, reused backbones and gains, conditions, maps, LOO semantics, estimands, thresholds, and both-seed rule remain unchanged.
